random_target_rule: for j=0,1,2 choose k=1+int(SHA256(UTF8(seed+':'+p+':'+j)).hexdigest(),16) mod (q-1), require distinct k and exclude control scalars; construct T=k*Qbar outside timing; pass only public coordinates to lift search
canonical_lift_law: in increasing H=max(abs(a),b) from 1 to 8192, then b and a, test b>=1, gcd(abs(a),b)=1, b not divisible by p, x=a/b^2 reducing to supplied public x; test exact integral quadratic discriminant and both y roots; accept first exact rational point reducing to supplied (x,y)
lift_search_status: found records exact (a,b,c) giving x=a/b^2,y=c/b^3; height_cap_exhausted and wall_cap_exhausted retain counters and cap; a found lift alone is a stage result and no scalar is returned by this arm
rho_arm: same public point T, pinned deterministic Floyd rho with target-specific hashed seed, independently verified scalar
target_order: Qbar, 2Qbar positive controls, then three SHA-256-seeded public points per reduction
arm_order: lift then rho for even zero-based target index; rho then lift for odd index
online_interval: lift timer includes target-conditioned b/a generation, all discriminant tests, found-point verification or cap; rho timer includes target-dependent walk through scalar verification; exclude process startup and curve/fixture construction
claim_boundary: fixed curve and two prime reductions; exact capped lift-stage coverage and same-public-point rho full-solve reference, with distinct result types and ordinary-host timing
